Capture decisions and next actions soon after the meeting, using the agreed record and correction process. You can leave an item explicitly undecided; a discussion does not have to produce an agreement.

## Completed example

*Illustrative example; replace these details with your own verified record.*

**Decision D-014:** Seek privacy advice before ethics submission because partner-led contact may reveal eligibility.
**Action A-031:** Student books consultation by Friday; evidence is calendar confirmation.
**Not decided:** final recruitment channel.
**Next review:** after consultation note is available.

## Check your record

Circulate the record for factual correction as agreed. Keep proposed wording distinguishable from a confirmed decision, and do not treat silence as formal approval.

## Scenario test

If participants remember a discussion differently, compare the recorded wording with the available evidence and invite timely factual correction. Mark the decision unresolved if agreement cannot yet be established; the existence of a meeting note does not make one account definitive.

## Privacy boundary

Record the project's decisions and progress here. Keep sensitive personal or case details in the appropriate confidential process.
